```
npx skills add superdesigndev/superdesign-skill
```

```
/plugin marketplace add superdesigndev/superdesign-skill

```

```
npm install -g @superdesign/cli@latest
superdesign login
```

## Use it

```
/superdesign set up a design system from my current codebase
```

```
/superdesign improve the design of my dashboard
```

# Skills
## Stageshow
[Permalink: Stageshow](https://github.com/benjitaylor/skills#stageshow)

[![Product UI illustrations made with Stageshow](https://github.com/benjitaylor/skills/raw/main/.github/assets/stageshow.png)](https://github.com/benjitaylor/skills/blob/main/.github/assets/stageshow.png)

feature cards, cursor demos and bento grids, built in React. It includes guidance on composition and motion, a kit to copy from, examples, and tools that film the result so the agent can check its work.

```
npx skills add benjitaylor/skills --skill stageshow
```

[How it works](https://benji.org/stageshow) · [Read the skill](https://github.com/benjitaylor/skills/blob/main/stageshow/SKILL.md) · [Preview the examples](https://github.com/benjitaylor/skills/blob/main/stageshow/README.md#preview)
